The display string is never the dirty-check baseline: `isDirty` and the save body read the stored value, so an untouched row stays out of the payload (Save disabled, nothing POSTed), and an untouched sibling field on an edited row is sent as stored (unrounded), while a field the user typed in is sent as the canonical decimal string they entered. | INV-SNAPSHOTS-11 | Replacing a snapshot archives, never overwrites. Every write that changes the values of an existing month (Edit `PATCH`, which is also Record snapshot's replace, bulk save, import) soft-deletes the live row and inserts the new values in **one transaction**, for all four snapshot groups and all three shapes (amount-only, quantity+price, accrued): afterwards the month has exactly one live row holding the new values and the displaced row survives as an ordinary soft-deleted row. `supersedes` stays **null** on both (it keeps its one meaning, "a close row displaced this", ADR-0052 §2), so a compacted backup does not carry the displaced row. A row whose fields (amount, currency, quantity / price per unit / accrued interest where the shape has them, as-of date, note) all equal the live row's, compared as decimals, is **unchanged** and writes nothing; re-importing identical data creates no archived rows. A failure midway leaves nothing changed, a soft-deleted month is inserted rather than replaced, another household's row is rejected untouched, and the single-write response names the displaced row (`replaced_id`, null when nothing was replaced) while bulk responses tally `replaced` and `unchanged`. The month's report still regenerates, since the watermark counts archived rows | `backend/internal/backup/replace_snapshot_test.go`<br>`backend/internal/repo/snapshot_month_exists_test.go`<br>`backend/internal/repo/snapshot_replace_test.go`<br>`backend/internal/repo/snapshot_unchanged_internal_test.go` |
| INV-SNAPSHOTS-12 | Record snapshot follows one overwrite rule on all three snapshot shapes (amount-only, quantity × price, accrued interest). The dialog opens on the month after the latest snapshot, capped at the current month, with the value fields **empty**; an empty month offers a muted "Last recorded" line and **Same as last month**, which fills only the value fields (amount, or quantity × price, or total + accrued) from the latest earlier snapshot and **never the statement date**. A month that already has a snapshot (the default month when the current one is recorded, or one picked) switches the dialog to **replace mode** before anything is sent: a notice names the month and its existing value, the fields are prefilled from it, and Save goes through the update (`PATCH`) path so the earlier value is archived (INV-SNAPSHOTS-11) and the single toast offers Undo through the replace-undo route (INV-SOFT-DELETE-09); the create `POST` is not called for a recorded month. Moving from a replaced month to an empty one drops the prefilled values. Verified in `CreateSnapshotDialog.test.tsx`, `RecordSnapshotShapes.test.tsx` and `RecordSnapshotReplace.test.tsx`, with the server-side guard in `snapshot_month_exists_test.go` | `frontend/src/components/dialogs/CreateSnapshotDialog.test.tsx`<br>`frontend/src/components/dialogs/RecordSnapshotReplace.test.tsx`<br>`frontend/src/components/dialogs/RecordSnapshotShapes.test.tsx` |
| INV-SNAPSHOTS-13 | A snapshot's statement date (`as_of_date`) is never invented. Bulk monthly entry starts the date **blank** (no end-of-month seed, and no per-user preference to seed from: `users.carryover_date_mode` was dropped), a month change clears a date picked for the old month rather than re-seeding one, and every snapshot dialog starts blank too. A save that carries no date (key absent, `null`, or the empty string a cleared date input sends) stores `as_of_date = NULL`; a date the user picks is stored as picked and stays bound to the snapshot's month (the in-month CHECK, INV-SNAPSHOTS-01). Nothing computes from the date, so a blank one never changes a figure. Verified in `EntryScreen.statementDate.test.tsx` (blank, sent as null, picked, cleared on month change) and, against a raw `as_of_date` read, `statement_date_test.go` (bulk and single create) | `backend/internal/assets/statement_date_test.go`<br>`backend/internal/repo/snapshot_move_test.go`<br>`frontend/src/components/entry/EntryScreen.statementDate.test.tsx` |
| INV-SNAPSHOTS-14 | Bulk monthly entry can record a balance that did not move without ever saving everything. A carried-forward row (value from an earlier month, none yet this month) has a **Same** checkbox (a header checkbox per group on desktop, an "All same" toolbar checkbox on mobile, ticks or unticks every markable row); a marked row shows a muted "Same as {month}" and is sent in the payload with values equal to its stored prefill (all three shapes: amount; quantity × price; accrued), so it becomes this month's Snapshot and the position leaves the month's stale list. Typing into a marked row (or Undo) unmarks it. An untouched row is never sent (Save stays disabled with nothing changed or marked), and a month that already has a value shows a muted "Current: …" with no Unchanged action. | INV-SNAPSHOTS-15 | A snapshot moves to another month in **one atomic step**, for all four groups and all three shapes (`POST …/snapshots/{id}/move`, body `{year_month}`). In one transaction the original is archived (soft-deleted), whatever live row the target month held is archived the same way, and the same values (amount, currency, quantity / price / accrued where the shape has them, note) are inserted in the target month: afterwards the source month has no live row, the target exactly one, `supersedes` is null (INV-SNAPSHOTS-11), and the response's `replaced_id` names the displaced target row (null when the month was empty). Unlike an Edit it never takes the "unchanged" shortcut, so a target holding identical values is still archived and named. The statement date is **not** carried (the in-month CHECK pins it to the month it left, so it is NULL on the new row, never invented, INV-SNAPSHOTS-13). Refused with nothing changed: the snapshot's own month (400 `SNAPSHOT_MOVE_SAME_MONTH`), a future month (400 `FUTURE_YEAR_MONTH`), a time deposit's month outside its term (400 `OUTSIDE_DEPOSIT_TERM`), another household's or a soft-deleted snapshot (404), and a **close snapshot** (409 `SNAPSHOT_CLOSE_NOT_MOVABLE`: the row naming what it displaced in `supersedes`, or a 0-value row at a terminated Position's termination month), which stays close-only (INV-LIFECYCLE-03/04). A failure after either archive rolls both back. Both months' reports are rebuilt (the archives and the insert move the watermark, INV-SOFT-DELETE-11). The Edit snapshot dialog keeps the month read-only and offers **Move…** (a month picker up to the current month, the replace notice when the target is taken, one toast with Undo, INV-SOFT-DELETE-13); the four-step "wrong month" hint is gone. Verified in `snapshot_move_test.go`, the per-group `move_test.go` handler tests and `MoveSnapshotDialog.test.tsx` | `backend/internal/assets/move_test.go`<br>`backend/internal/investments/move_test.go`<br>`backend/internal/liabilities/move_test.go`<br>`backend/internal/receivables/move_test.go`<br>`backend/internal/repo/snapshot_move_test.go`<br>`frontend/src/components/dialogs/MoveSnapshotDialog.test.tsx` |

| INV-SNAPSHOTS-17 | A time deposit snapshot is entered as **one Value** (the net figure its statement shows) and the server derives `accrued_interest = Value − principal in force`, on every write path a person uses: the per-position create and edit (`POST`/`PATCH …/snapshots`) and the accrued bulk save, whatever `accrued_interest` the client sent (it may be omitted, and is ignored when present). Principal in force is the deposit's own `time_deposit_details.principal`: a deposit carries one principal for its term, and a rollover creates a successor row whose principal is the rolled amount (ADR-0009), so an `auto_renew_with_interest` successor derives from the rolled principal, not the matured deposit's. A Value below the principal stores a negative interest and still saves (the form only warns); `total_value` stays the entered Value and the row keeps the accrued shape (quantity/price null). A bond is untouched: it still requires `accrued_interest` and stores it as given. The close snapshot (0/0, INV-LIFECYCLE-03) and workbook import write their figures directly and are out of this rule.
